name: easyslip/sdk
description: Official EasySlip SDK for PHP: verify Thai bank slips and TrueMoney Wallet receipts, generate payment QR codes and check webhook signatures.

scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan at the max level over src and examples.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run every check that CI runs, except the package and integration checks.
scripts-descriptions.check:package: Build the package archive, install it in a fresh project and make an offline call.
scripts-descriptions.check:readme: Check that every PHP code block in the READMEs is valid and passes PHPStan.
scripts-descriptions.format:check: Check the formatting without changing files.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Check the syntax of every PHP file.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit and conformance tests.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the unit and conformance tests with a coverage report.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the integration tests against the live API (needs EASYSLIP_API_KEY).
